channel.title: Yashraj Bhogade - Blog

item.title: Prompt Injection: Inside the Broken Trust Boundary

item.description: Comparing Parrot Security OS and Omarchy (Hyprland on Arch) across kernel isolation, offensive tooling, reproducibility, and daily engineering friction.

item.description: Step-by-step implementation of feedforward neural networks, forward propagation, and backpropagation in ANSI C with zero external ML libraries.
